rules.title: Plaza Special Performance Permit — Resolution 116-2023
rules.summary: Exhibit A sets permit, scheduling, location, conduct, commercial-recording, revocation, and appeal conditions. Review the adopted text rather than treating staff’s constitutional assurances as a holding.
open_questions: Meaning of performance and treatment of spontaneous or small-scale expression.
Current film-permit framework and exemptions; §3.8.7 concerns performance permit holders.
Constitutional fit of lead time, daily cap, language restrictions, discretion, and appeal.

cpra_targets.target: Current Plaza, special-event, and film-permit policies, amendments, exemptions, written staff guidance, and existing permit/denial/revocation index.
cpra_targets.why: Resolve actual rule scope and implementation before assigning constitutional or historical enforcement findings.

cpra_targets.target: Park title/control and perimeter/street-side right-of-way plans.
cpra_targets.why: Official park identity is established; exact parcel and ROW edges are not.
